recommendation_summary: Boğaziçi University is recommended for a visit due to its status as a major research university and its scenic location on the European side of the Bosphorus strait, offering a broader experience. The Endem TV Tower's revolving restaurant, a key attraction, is now closed, leaving only an observation deck.
